name: dap
description: Debug C/C++ programs using GDB's or LLDB's built-in Debug Adapter Protocol support

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration

kdap.gdb.path.description: The path to the gdb binary. Defaults to searching for 'gdb' in PATH.

kdap.lldb.path.description: The path to the lldb-dap binary. Defaults to searching for 'lldb-dap', then 'lldb-dap-<version>', in PATH; on macOS, where Xcode keeps lldb-dap out of PATH, it then asks xcrun for it.

kdap.logPath.description: Enable DAP logging. Logs are written to this filename. If empty, logging is disabled.

kdap.gdb.logLevel.description: Set gdb's DAP logging level. The default is 1, which logs the DAP protocol and unexpected exceptions. Level 2 also logs exceptions that are considered expected, such as a failure to parse an expression.

kdap.environment.description: Extra environment variables to set on the debugger process.

debuggerPath.markdownDescription: The path to the gdb executable to use.

sysroot.description: Path to the system root gdb should use when looking for shared libraries and debug info, as if by 'set sysroot'. If empty or omitted, gdb's default sysroot handling applies.

skipInitFiles.description: Skip reading the debugger's own init files. For gdb, as if by passing '-nx'.

sourceFileMap.description: Maps source paths recorded in the debug info to their location on disk, as if by 'set substitute-path'. Each key is the path as recorded in the debug info and each value is where that path is found locally.

qtPrettyPrinters.description: Automatically load Qt pretty-printers for gdb. If they haven't been downloaded yet, starting a debug session offers to download them.

program.description: Path to the executable to debug. Corresponds to gdb's 'file' command.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the inferior, as if by 'set args'.

cwd.markdownDescription: The working directory for gdb and the launched program. If omitted, gdb inherits VS Code's working directory rather than the workspace folder, so set this explicitly (e.g. `${workspaceFolder}`).

env.description: Environment variables for the inferior. Each key is a variable name and each value must be a string. Setting this replaces the inferior's entire environment rather than adding to it, so PATH, HOME and friends must be listed too. If omitted, the inferior inherits gdb's environment.

stopAtBeginningOfMainSubprogram.description: Set a temporary breakpoint at the program's main procedure, as if by the 'start' command.

stopOnEntry.description: Set a temporary breakpoint at the program's first instruction, as if by the 'starti' command.

debuggerPath.markdownDescription: The path to the gdb executable to use.

sysroot.description: Path to the system root gdb should use when looking for shared libraries and debug info, as if by 'set sysroot'. If empty or omitted, gdb's default sysroot handling applies.

skipInitFiles.description: Skip reading the debugger's own init files. For gdb, as if by passing '-nx'.

sourceFileMap.description: Maps source paths recorded in the debug info to their location on disk, as if by 'set substitute-path'. Each key is the path as recorded in the debug info and each value is where that path is found locally.

qtPrettyPrinters.description: Automatically load Qt pretty-printers for gdb. If they haven't been downloaded yet, starting a debug session offers to download them.

pid.description: The process ID to which gdb should attach.

program.description: Path to the executable being debugged. In some cases gdb can determine this automatically, but for many remote targets it must be supplied.

target.description: The target to which gdb should connect, passed to the 'target remote' command.

coreFile.description: Path to a core dump file to load instead of attaching to a live process.

debuggerPath.markdownDescription: The path to the lldb-dap executable to use.

sourceFileMap.description: Maps source paths recorded in the debug info to their location on disk, as if by 'settings set target.source-map'. Each key is the path as recorded in the debug info and each value is where that path is found locally.

qtPrettyPrinters.description: Load the Qt pretty-printers bundled with this extension by importing them as an lldb Python module.

program.description: Path to the executable to debug.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the inferior.

cwd.markdownDescription: The working directory for lldb-dap and the launched program. If omitted, lldb-dap inherits VS Code's working directory rather than the workspace folder, so set this explicitly (e.g. `${workspaceFolder}`).

env.description: Environment variables for the inferior. Each key is a variable name and each value must be a string. These are added to the environment the inferior inherits rather than replacing it.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the program's entry point.

initCommands.description: lldb commands run once the debugger has been created, before the target exists. The place for 'platform select', pretty printer scripts, and anything else that must precede the target.

preRunCommands.description: lldb commands run after the target is created but before the program is launched or attached to.

postRunCommands.description: lldb commands run once the program has been launched or attached to.

stopCommands.description: lldb commands run each time the program stops.

exitCommands.description: lldb commands run once the program has exited.

terminateCommands.description: lldb commands run when the debug session ends.

platformName.description: The lldb platform to select, as if by 'platform select'. Needed for remote targets.

targetTriple.description: The target triple to debug for, overriding the one recorded in the executable.

debuggerRoot.description: Directory lldb-dap chdirs to before doing anything else, so that relative paths in commands resolve predictably.

enableAutoVariableSummaries.description: Show auto-generated summaries for variables when no language-specific summary applies.

enableSyntheticChildDebugging.description: Alongside a synthetic child, also show the raw value it was synthesised from.

displayExtendedBacktrace.description: Include extended backtraces, where the platform provides them.

customFrameFormat.description: Format string for stack frame names, using lldb's frame-format syntax.

customThreadFormat.description: Format string for thread names, using lldb's thread-format syntax.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for launchCommands or attachCommands to establish a valid target.

launchCommands.description: lldb commands used to launch the program instead of lldb-dap doing it. The last of them must leave a valid, launched target.

runInTerminal.description: Launch the program in an integrated terminal, so that it can read from stdin.

disableASLR.description: Disable address space layout randomisation for the program.

disableSTDIO.description: Launch the program without stdin, stdout or stderr.

shellExpandArguments.description: Let a shell expand the program's arguments before launching it.

detachOnError.description: Detach from the program if an error is encountered while launching it.
